chunks.text: At Northstar Systems from 2021 to 2024, built Python and FastAPI backend services with PostgreSQL and Redis.
Improved billing API p99 latency from 900 ms to 240 ms by adding database connection pooling.
Led a five-engineer team during migration of the internal billing service and coordinated weekly release reviews.
Deployed event-driven ingestion workers to AWS SQS and S3 at Northstar Systems.
A personal project uses PostgreSQL, FastAPI, and automated integration tests.
Bachelor of Science in Information Systems, Western State University, 2019.
